title: We Are South Maui CPAC Meeting of October 23, 2023

issues.title: Maui Research and Technology Park land designation

recap.headline: South Maui plan advisory group falls short of votes to send plan on, recesses
recap.in_60_seconds: The South Maui Community Plan Advisory Committee met to finish reviewing its draft community plan and decide whether to send it to the Maui Planning Commission. Members adopted several text changes, set nearly all unprioritized actions to high priority, and added an action for a safe crossing of Pi’ilani Highway by the new high school. A proposed list of historic and cultural sites failed 4 to 5. Nine members of the public testified, split between asking for more time and asking the group to finish. The motion to send the plan to the Planning Commission got 5 yes and 3 no votes, short of the 7 needed. The committee recessed to November 1 at 5:30 p.m., and the Planning Department said it will not seek more time beyond this meeting.

parts.title: Opening, roll call and vision statement
presented: Meeting started at 5:30 p.m. with roll call; several members excused or absent
An opening oli was offered and a member read the South Maui vision statement
Chair said this may be one of the last meetings

parts.title: Final changes to plan sections 3 and 4 text
presented: Page 91 changed to use the actual name of the new high school, Kūlanihākoʻi High School
Page 96 updated to note the affordable housing project on the south side of Pi’ikea Avenue; Downtown Kīhei remains on the north side
Page 98 Maui Research and Technology Park description now lists conference rooms, an auditorium and an outdoor amphitheater
A paragraph on the Sub-area 3 coastline is still waiting on new language from two members

answered.said: The sub-area descriptions are descriptions of what might come to be, not policies or actions, so an outdoor event space can be added.
Late written testimony is accepted whenever it arrives, but that does not mean the committee must discuss it again.

next.what: Two members to bring new language for the Sub-area 3 coastline paragraph

parts.title: Setting priorities for plan actions
presented: A member's proposed priorities for unranked actions were read, covering parks, housing, short-term rental enforcement, wildfire plans, R-1 recycled water and plan tracking
Amendments raised youth athletic fields, hotel shuttles and plan-tracking actions to high, so all became high priority
New action added: research, identify and carry out a safe crossing of Pi’ilani Highway by the high school
An action for yearly review of a living list of cultural sites was withdrawn for now

answered.said: A local community association plans to fund water quality testing with partners and survey all area workers about housing and transportation needs, with results hoped for by February.
Changing the list in the community plan would require a County Council decision.

next.what: Department of Education meeting at the high school on the highway overpass

parts.title: List of historic, cultural and scenic sites
presented: County code requires the plan to include a list of historic, cultural and scenic sites; a resident's list of 100-plus sites was proposed
The County is updating its 1984 Cultural Resources Management Plan; phase one is done
Planner said none of the listed sites has been vetted, and the State Historic Preservation Division is the authority, so wording should say sites that 'may have' significance
Motion to adopt the list failed, 4 yes and 5 no

raised.concern: The resident who compiled the list said sites marked for preservation get forgotten and bulldozed, and developers should be required to check the state HICRIS map.

answered.said: Anyone wanting a property listed would file a nomination with the Hawaiʻi State Review Board, which checks significance and integrity.

parts.title: Appendices
presented: Appendix will say where to find community association design guidelines rather than include the documents
Outdated Council committee name to be replaced with the current one
Definitions of bypass and collector roads to be added
Appendix will reference the revised Maui County Cultural Resources Management Plan for significant sites once adopted

parts.title: Public testimony on a time extension (Item C)

raised.concern: A Waipuʻolani Road property owner said their R-3 parcel, planned for 28 workforce units, was mapped as open space with no outreach, and asked for a one-year extension.
South Maui has no member on the Planning Commission, which a testifier called a violation of the charter amendment.
More time is needed because of short meeting notice, canceled meetings and limited public participation.
Commercial zoning for the Pi’ilani Promenade should be removed because of community opposition, drainage and archaeological sites.
The plan allows too much development without roads, schools and drainage to support it, and little affordable housing.
Every project should identify cultural sites and include a HICRIS map before it is considered.
Known, recorded burial sites were removed from the map.
Hold one or more meetings focused only on affordable housing in South Maui.
Do not ask for more time; the plan must move on so housing projects and West Maui work can proceed.

answered.said: The plan is not final tonight; it goes to the Planning Commission, then the County Council with public hearings, so there are more chances to testify.

parts.title: Public testimony on final approval (Item D)

raised.concern: The plan allows about 6,000 to 7,000 units for 18,000 to 21,000 people, far above the 3,000 to 6,000 residents it was told to plan for, including 1,250 homes at the Research and Technology Park.
The plan should require water-saving plans and proof of water before projects are approved.

next.what: Testifier urged members to attend Planning Commission and Council meetings on the plan
next.when: until the Council adopts the plan

parts.title: Vote to send the draft plan to the Planning Commission
presented: Motion to recommend approval of sending the amended draft plan to the Maui Planning Commission
Vote was 5 yes, 3 no; 7 votes are needed, so the plan was not sent

answered.said: An idea for a HICRIS mapping policy can be raised when the Planning Commission reviews the plan.

parts.title: What happens next
presented: Department will seek an after-the-fact extension up to tonight but will not support more time
Corporation Counsel said the committee exists until Council adopts the plan, but any action needs 7 votes
Without a committee recommendation the department could send its own; counsel called that unprecedented
Staff said they would give the Planning Commission all committee changes either way

answered.said: The department has reached the limit of its resources and will not ask for a time extension beyond tonight.

next.when: by the end of the week

parts.title: Recess
presented: Committee voted to recess at 8:46 p.m. and reconvene at the Mālama Center if available

next.what: Meeting resumes to handle final approval

bills.name: South Maui Community Plan (draft)
bills.what: The 20-year plan for South Maui land use, housing, infrastructure and culture that the committee is reviewing.

bills.name: 2016 South Maui Community Wildfire Protection Plan
bills.what: Wildfire plan that a high-priority action says should be updated and enforced.

bills.name: July 2021 Cost of Government Commission report on wildfire prevention
bills.what: Report on wildfire prevention and cost recovery that an action says should be implemented.

bills.name: Maui County Code Chapter 2.80B
bills.what: County law requiring community plans to include a list of historic, cultural and scenic sites.

bills.name: 1984 Maui County Cultural Resources Management Plan
bills.what: County plan for cultural sites now being updated, which the appendix will reference once adopted.

bills.name: 1998 Kīhei-Mākena Community Plan
bills.what: The current community plan, which lists 31 important sites.

bills.name: Charter amendment on Planning Commission membership
bills.what: Requires each district to have a member and no more than two from one district.

bills.name: Show Me the Water bill
bills.what: Proposal requiring proof of water before projects are approved.

votes.what: Use Kūlanihākoʻi High School name on page 91
Note affordable housing project south of Downtown Kīhei on page 96
Add conference rooms, auditorium and outdoor amphitheater to page 98
Set all unranked actions to high priority
Add action for safe crossing of Pi’ilani Highway by the high school
Adopt resident's list of significant sites
Reference where to find community association design guidelines in appendix
Reference revised Cultural Resources Management Plan for significant sites
Recommend sending amended draft plan to Maui Planning Commission

open_questions.question: Who would verify and add new sites to a living list of significant places in South Maui?
What happens to the plan if the committee cannot reach seven votes?
Why was the Waipuʻolani Road parcel mapped as open space, and will landowners be contacted?
When will South Maui get a member on the Maui Planning Commission?

not_on_tracker.topic: South Maui representation on the Maui Planning Commission
not_on_tracker.why: Testifiers said the next body to review the plan has no South Maui member.
Testifiers said the area has drainage problems and archaeological sites and the community opposed commercial use.

not_on_tracker.topic: Significant cultural sites list and known burials
not_on_tracker.why: Residents worry sites will be lost to development without a list or required HICRIS checks.

not_on_tracker.topic: Safe crossing of Pi’ilani Highway by the new high school
not_on_tracker.why: Students need a safe way to cross to the school.

moments.who: A Kīhei property owner on Waipuʻolani Road
moments.quote: it is saying that this is going to be designated open space, even though it's zoned R3. And so, again, I would request that you take more time to properly vet this.
moments.about: A landowner who had planned workforce housing on the parcel said the draft plan would mark her residentially zoned property as open space without outreach to her.

moments.quote: The drainage plan for South Maui is not planned until 2040, and at which time we will be working on a new community plan.
moments.about: A resident argued that infrastructure such as drainage must come before the new development the plan allows, citing flooding and fire risk.

moments.quote: and what we would do as a department is we would take all the things that you folks recommended, because you folks put a year's worth of work in here, and we would present that to the Maui Planning Commission.
moments.about: After the advisory committee failed to get seven votes to send the draft plan forward, staff explained that the department would still pass the committee's recommended changes to the Planning Commission if no vote succeeds.
